title: 加纳称角色没变：路演却交给CEO和CFO，那她管什么？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Now, we do want to stick with the consumer here and talk about baby food or at least children's food.
segments.zh: 现在，我们想继续关注消费领域，谈谈婴儿食品，或者至少是儿童食品。

segments.en: Once upon a farm launching its newest refrigerated pouch called electrolyte blends looking to expand its portfolio and reach more families in the grocery stores. More than just infants, it's now bigger kids.
segments.zh: Once Upon a Farm 推出了最新的冷藏袋装产品，名为电解质混合饮品，旨在扩大产品组合并触达更多家庭，不仅限于婴儿，现在也面向大孩子。

segments.en: Jennifer Garner, the co-founder and chief brand officer, she's not by the program a little bit earlier to talk about her mission. Here's what she had to say.
segments.zh: 联合创始人兼首席品牌官詹妮弗·加纳早些时候来到节目，谈论她的使命。以下是她的分享。

segments.en: I want to say that my role has changed that much. I did go on a bunch of investor meetings and then I also went on the road show or was part of the road show as we were leading up to our IPO.
segments.zh: 我想说我的角色变化没那么大。我确实参加了一些市场参与者会议，也在IPO前参与了路演。

segments.en: Most of the investor meetings at this moment have been handled by our CEO and CFO John Forker and Larry Waldman and I'm sure that I'll get back in there. I'm always like,
segments.zh: 目前大多数市场参与者会议都由我们的CEO和CFO约翰·福克和拉里·沃尔德曼处理，我相信我会重新参与。我总是说，

segments.en: do you want me to read earnings reports or anything? So at some point I'll get back in there but right now it's all business. I have the double down and I actually took part of the summer and the fall
segments.zh: 需要我读财报之类的吗？所以某个时候我会重新参与，但现在全是业务。我加倍投入，实际上夏天和秋天部分时间

segments.en: off to be available and to make sure that I was going back and seeing all of our retailers again so that they know. I'm still here. We're still doing this. This is business as usual, which means
segments.zh: 我抽出时间确保能再次拜访所有零售商，让他们知道我还在这里，我们还在做这件事。这是常态业务，意味着

segments.en: me and the meetings, which means me going to farms and meeting our suppliers and talking to the suppliers to people all about everything that we do and just very involved in any way that I can get my
segments.zh: 我和会议，意味着我去农场、见供应商，与供应商和人们谈论我们做的一切，非常投入，尽我所能

segments.en: hands dirty. I like to be there. Well, remind me again. How did you get involved with Cassandra and Ari
segments.zh: 亲力亲为。我喜欢在那里。再提醒我一下，你是怎么和卡桑德拉和阿里一起参与的？
